surface.description: The surface a route reports (the tag or a safe guess, else unknown).

cost_surface.description: The surface class the cost uses, and where it comes from.

traffic.description:
The traffic level, 0..=1, that `quiet` penalises: the louder of the way's own and the
traffic it gets from the roads beside it.

attributes.description: Every attribute the graph keeps for the edge.

plan_override.description: This plan's override on the edge, if any ("avoided in this plan").

along.description: Along the geometry (`from → to`) and against it.

WayKind.description: The way types of the route breakdown.

oneOf.description: Trunk, primary, secondary.
Tertiary, unclassified.
A separate cycle path away from motor roads.
A separate cycle path beside a motor road.

SurfaceKind.description: The surface classes of the result (the tag or a safe guess; `unknown` where neither).

SurfaceSource.description: How sure the surface the cost uses is.

oneOf.description: From the `surface` tag.
Untagged, a safe guess from the way (counts like a tag).

Untagged, a guess: counts 0.7 for the surface preferences, closed by `paved_only` and
`no_unknown_surface`.

TrafficFrom.description: Where the traffic level of an edge comes from.

oneOf.description: The way's own traffic (road class, speed, lanes, access, a cycle track on it); 0 on paths.

The motor roads within 20 m: their level (`road_near_traffic`) × the share of the way near
them (`road_near_share`) × 0.3, louder than the way's own.

Attribute.description:
One attribute of the edge, named by its `edges.parquet` column (the names the catalogue's
`coverage.attribute` uses), as the graph keeps it (quantised).

AttrValue.description: An attribute's value: an enum's label, a number, a flag; `null` unknown.

Bounds.description:
The clamp of the factor product (`docs/profile.md`): every arc costs between `min_factor` and
`max_factor` times its length (plus additive terms). `min_factor` is the A* bound.

min_factor.description: 0.3..=1.0, default 0.5. Lower lets bonuses stack further (and searches slow down a little).

max_factor.description: 2..=100, default 20. The most an allowed way can cost per metre.

OverrideKind.description: What an override does to its edge.

oneOf.description: Not ridden unless there is no other way ([`AVOID_M`] per full arc on top).
Counts at the profile's `min_factor` (plus its additive terms); the limits do not close it.
The limits do not close it (a bicycle ban and one-way still do); costed as if they were off.

ArcCostExplanation.description: One direction of an edge, explained.

preferences.description: Every active preference (weight ≠ 0), catalogue order, also where its factor is 1.

quality.description: The product of the quality factors, the gated penalties and the ramps.

bonus.description: The product of the gated bonuses (before the gate).

gate.description: How much of the bonus counts, 0..=1: 1 up to quality 1.3, 0 from 2.2.

raw_factor.description: `quality × (1 + (bonus − 1) × gate)`: the factor before the clamp.

factor.description: After the clamp to the profile's bounds.

clamp.description: Set when the clamp changed the factor: which bound.

ascent_m.description: Ascent beyond the deadband, metres; the tamed steepest grade up and down, percent.

additive.description: The additive terms that are not 0.

cost.description:
The arc's cost the router uses (metres-equivalent): `length × factor + extra_m`, or what this
plan's override makes of it. Absent when closed.

base_cost.description:
With an override that changes the cost (avoid, prefer): the profile's cost without it (absent
where the profile closes the arc).

closed_by.description: Everything that closes this direction (empty: open), in the order the engine checks.

lifted.description: The limits this plan's override (allow, prefer) lifts here: they would close it.

structured.description:
Structured model: the boards' rows and tiers, what counts per group, the relative factor,
the hills curve's reading.

PrefPart.description: One active preference's part in an arc's cost.

membership.description:
How much the way is what the preference names, −1..=1, quantised to fifteenths as the cost
uses it. `climb`: the average grade beyond the deadband over 5 %.

factor.description:
Its factor here (1: no effect; < 1 cheaper, > 1 dearer). A `gated_bonus` counts only
through the gate; an `additive` one (avoiding climbs) has none, its metres are in `additive`.

counted.description:
Structured model: whether it counts (only the strongest bonus and penalty of its group do).
Absent in the slider model, where every preference counts.

PrefId.description: A soft preference of the catalogue (`catalogue().preferences`).

Role.description: How a preference enters an arc's factor.

oneOf.description: Multiplies into the quality product.
A gated preference whose factor here is a penalty (> 1): it counts like quality.
A gated preference whose factor here is a bonus (≤ 1): it counts through the gate.
Avoiding climbs: no factor, metres of cost per metre of ascent (the `climb` additive term).
Raised to `bounds.min_factor` (the detour budget).
Lowered to `bounds.max_factor`.

Additive.description: An additive term: metres of cost on top of `length × factor`.

oneOf.description: Avoiding climbs: metres per metre of ascent beyond the deadband.
Gates, bollards, … on the edge's nodes.
Carrying.
`bicycle=dismount`: walking.
The wait.
The hills curve (structured model): `length × (curve − 1)`, < 0 where it seeks climbs.

Closure.description: Something that closes an arc, with the attribute that triggers it.

attribute.description: The `edges.parquet` column (or `tamed_grade_pct`, `surface_guess`) and its value here.

ClosedBy.description:
What closes an arc: a limit of the profile (the catalogue's limit ids) or a rule that holds
whatever the profile. In typed arrays as [`ClosedBy::code`].

oneOf.description: `bicycle=no` (the pipeline maps motor roads to it): never, whatever the profile.
Against a one-way: never.
A surface row on `avoid` (structured model: the surface board's limit).
A way row on `avoid` (structured model: the way board's limit).

StructuredParts.description: An arc's cost under the structured model, its parts.

boards.description: The way's row and tier on each board present.

groups.description: Per catalogue group with active sliders: what counts.

best.description:
The profile's best absolute factor (boards at love, every group at its strongest bonus):
`relative = raw_factor / best`.

relative.description: The factor relative to the best, before the spread: ≥ 1.

detours.description: The spread exponent: `factor = min(relative ^ detours, max_factor)`.

BoardPart.description: A board's part in an arc's cost: the way's row and its tier.

factor.description:
The tier's factor relative to `love` (`avoid`: `dislike`'s, what it counts where this plan
allows it).

vs_fine.description: The same relative to `fine` (the neutral tier).

BoardId.description: A board of the structured model.

BoardRow.description: A row of a board: every way is in exactly one row of each board ([`BoardRow::board`]).

Tier.description: A tier of a board: how much the rider likes the ways of a row, best first in [`Tier::BEST_FIRST`].

GroupPart.description:
A catalogue group's part in an arc's cost (structured model): of its active slider
preferences only the strongest bonus and the strongest penalty count (and the strongest gated
bonus, through the gate).

best.description: The best this group can do anywhere (its part of the profile's `best`).

Reason.description: One preference's part in a cost: its factor (< 1 made it cheaper, > 1 dearer).

HillsPart.description: The hills curve's part in an arc's cost.

value.description: What a metre of the arc counts relative to flat.

wall_pct.description:
The grades the curve read (percent, signed: < 0 downhill; loose ground steeper) and the
metres at each: the steepest 50 m, the rest's climbing and descending part.

loose.description: Loose ground (gravel, soft, unusual): its grades read `loose_pct` steeper.
